repositories.name: ApiSpark
repositories.description: ApiSpark

ai_summary.summary: ApiSpark is a modular ASP.NET Core backend API platform that consolidates multiple low-volume personal and portfolio APIs into a single Azure-hosted service. It demonstrates cost-effective multi-API hosting using EF Core and SQLite, with support for static sites, SPAs, and browser-based CMS capabilities.
ai_summary.purpose: Provides a consolidated, cost-effective API backend for multiple static websites and applications while maintaining separation between public, admin, and integration endpoints.
ai_summary.target_audience: Developers and technical architects seeking to host multiple small APIs cost-effectively on Azure using .NET, or those building static-first architectures with centralized API services.

repositories.name: AsyncSpark
repositories.description: Demonstration of some Async Methods

ai_summary.summary: AsyncSpark is a production-ready reference implementation demonstrating enterprise-grade async/await patterns and best practices in .NET 10. It showcases modern C# async programming with enforced code coverage (80% minimum), constitution-driven development practices, and resilience patterns including retry and circuit breaker policies via Polly integration.
ai_summary.purpose: To provide a comprehensive, audited example of how to implement async/await correctly in .NET applications with enterprise-grade quality standards and automated compliance enforcement.
tech_highlights: ASP.NET Core with interactive API documentation (Scalar)
ai_summary.target_audience: C# developers and architects seeking to understand and implement production-grade async patterns and enterprise coding standards in .NET applications.

repositories.name: BootstrapSpark
repositories.description: ReactSparkPortfolio is a production-ready, enterprise-grade developer portfolio built with React 19, TypeScript, and Vite.

ai_summary.summary: BootstrapSpark is a production-ready developer portfolio application built with React 19, TypeScript, and Vite that demonstrates enterprise-grade web development practices. It showcases modern frontend engineering, serverless architecture, and cloud-native deployment patterns with comprehensive CI/CD integration and SEO optimization.
ai_summary.purpose: To serve as both a personal portfolio and a comprehensive technical reference implementation for building scalable, enterprise-grade React applications.
ai_summary.target_audience: Developers, technical architects, and engineers seeking to learn enterprise-grade React development patterns and best practices for portfolio or production applications.

repositories.name: DataSpark
repositories.description: A .NET 10 toolkit for working with SQLite databases: discover files, export tables to CSV, inspect schema, and generate C# DTOs. The solution includes a CLI, a web UI, a core library, tests, and benchmarks.

ai_summary.summary: DataSpark is a comprehensive .NET 10 toolkit for SQLite database management that enables users to discover database files, export tables to CSV, inspect schemas, and automatically generate C# DTOs. The solution provides both a command-line interface and an ASP.NET Core web UI, with supporting core libraries, tests, and performance benchmarks.
ai_summary.purpose: To simplify SQLite database exploration and C# code generation by providing automated tools for schema analysis, data export, and DTO creation.
ai_summary.target_audience: C# developers who need to work with SQLite databases and require rapid schema exploration, data export, and code generation capabilities.

repositories.name: devspark
repositories.description: Build high-quality software faster with AI-driven lifecycle management.

ai_summary.summary: DevSpark is a structured development lifecycle framework delivered as markdown prompt templates and scripts that work with multiple AI coding assistants (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, etc.). It provides 28 slash-command prompts and helper scripts to guide AI assistants through a complete software development workflow from requirements specification to release, requiring no installation—just copying files into a project.
ai_summary.purpose: Enable AI coding assistants to follow a repeatable, structured development process with consistent prompts and workflows across the entire software lifecycle.
ai_summary.target_audience: Software developers and teams using AI coding assistants who want to implement structured, repeatable development workflows and lifecycle management processes.

repositories.name: DocSpecSpark
repositories.description: Document Spec Kit Spark

ai_summary.summary: DocSpecSpark is a document AI tool that provides AI assistants with a structured workflow for creating and managing documentation systems using markdown prompts and lightweight CLI tooling. It consists of 21 document workflow templates, agent-specific quickstart prompts, and an optional Python CLI for automated installation into target repositories.
ai_summary.purpose: Enable AI assistants to systematically create, review, evolve, and publish professional documentation systems through repeatable prompt-based workflows.
ai_summary.target_audience: Software teams and AI assistants seeking a structured, template-driven approach to documentation system creation and maintenance.

repositories.name: FastEndpointApi
repositories.description: Demo of FastEndpoints Nuget Packages

ai_summary.summary: FastEndpointApi is a demonstration project showcasing the FastEndpoints NuGet framework for building high-performance ASP.NET Core APIs. It features a practical Person Management application with a live demo site, serving as an educational resource for developers learning the FastEndpoints framework.
ai_summary.purpose: To provide a hands-on example and guide for developers learning how to build clean, maintainable, and performant ASP.NET Core APIs using the FastEndpoints framework.
ai_summary.target_audience: ASP.NET Core developers seeking to learn and understand the FastEndpoints framework for building efficient REST APIs.

repositories.name: git-spark
repositories.description: A Git Reporting tool

ai_summary.summary: Git Spark is a Git repository analytics and reporting tool that analyzes commit history to generate interactive HTML reports with visualizations, contributor statistics, and file analysis. Built with PowerShell, TypeScript, and Node.js, it provides transparent insights into development patterns and contributor activity across Git repositories.
ai_summary.purpose: To analyze Git commit patterns and generate interactive analytics reports for understanding contributor activity, code changes, and development metrics.
ai_summary.target_audience: DevOps engineers, development team leads, and technical managers who need to analyze repository metrics and contributor activity patterns.

repositories.name: github-stats-spark
repositories.description: Automated GitHub profile statistics generator with beautiful SVG visualizations and AI-powered repository analysis

ai_summary.summary: Stats Spark is an automated GitHub analytics platform that generates beautiful SVG visualizations of GitHub profile statistics and provides AI-powered repository analysis through integration with Claude. The project combines Python backend services with a JavaScript/CSS frontend dashboard to transform GitHub activity data into actionable insights and interactive visualizations.
ai_summary.purpose: To help developers and teams visualize GitHub activity metrics and gain AI-powered insights into repository health, contribution patterns, and technology usage.
ai_summary.target_audience: Developers, technical leaders, and open source maintainers who want professional GitHub analytics visualizations and AI-powered repository insights.

repositories.name: InquirySpark
repositories.description: Spark Your Inquiry, Ignite Insights.

ai_summary.summary: InquirySpark is a .NET 10 MVC web application for survey/inquiry and decision-management, featuring a modern ASP.NET Core architecture with Bootstrap 5 and Entity Framework Core 10. The system uses read-only SQLite databases for persistence and demonstrates enterprise-grade web application patterns with minimal external dependencies.
ai_summary.purpose: To provide a unified, full-featured survey and inquiry management platform that showcases modern ASP.NET Core development practices and architectural patterns.
ai_summary.target_audience: Developers and architects seeking a reference implementation of modern ASP.NET Core patterns, or organizations needing a survey/inquiry management system.

repositories.name: KeyPressCounter
repositories.description: A very simple key press counter and logger for windows

ai_summary.summary: KeyPressCounter is a lightweight Windows system tray utility that monitors keyboard and mouse activity while simultaneously tracking real-time system performance metrics including CPU, memory, disk I/O, and network usage. The application provides a dashboard with input statistics, live performance graphs, and hardware information, all while running silently in the background without recording keystrokes or transmitting data.
ai_summary.purpose: Provides users with visibility into their keyboard/mouse activity patterns and system performance metrics through a non-invasive, privacy-respecting background utility.
tech_highlights: Real-time graphing with anti-aliased line charts
ai_summary.target_audience: Windows users who want to monitor their productivity metrics and system performance without sacrificing privacy or using resource-intensive tools.

ai_summary.summary: This is Mark Hazleton's personal GitHub profile repository serving as a dynamic archive of his learning journey in .NET and Azure technologies. It showcases multiple featured projects including WebSpark, ReactSpark, TailwindSpark, and UISampleSpark, along with technical articles on modern web development, cloud deployment, and software architecture.
ai_summary.purpose: To document and share a portfolio of learning milestones, demo applications, and technical insights in full-stack web development and cloud engineering.
ai_summary.target_audience: Developers interested in .NET, Azure, React, and modern web development practices, as well as those seeking technical articles on cloud deployment and UI frameworks.

repositories.name: markhazleton.github.io
repositories.description: This is the personal GitHub profile for Mark Hazleton

ai_summary.summary: This is Mark Hazleton's personal portfolio and blog website built with Jekyll and hosted on GitHub Pages. The site features a customized Minima theme with dark/light mode toggle, responsive design, and modern styling, deployed automatically via CI/CD.
ai_summary.purpose: To serve as a personal website and technical blog for Mark Hazleton with automated Jekyll-based content publishing.
ai_summary.target_audience: Visitors looking to learn about Mark Hazleton's work, projects, and technical writings through his personal blog.

repositories.name: MechanicsOfMotherhood
repositories.description: MechanicsOfMotherhood

ai_summary.summary: Mechanics of Motherhood is a production-ready recipe management platform built with React 19, TypeScript, and Vite, featuring 108+ curated recipes with mobile-first design and automated CI/CD deployment. The project demonstrates modern web development practices with a custom domain, API integration, and comprehensive build optimization including SSR and static generation capabilities.
ai_summary.purpose: To provide busy working mothers with an organized, intuitive recipe management platform that simplifies meal planning and kitchen organization.
ai_summary.target_audience: Busy working mothers and home cooks seeking an organized, mobile-friendly recipe management solution with curated content and smart categorization.

repositories.name: MuseumSpark
repositories.description: A Museum Trip Planning Application

ai_summary.summary: MuseumSpark is a museum trip planning application that transforms the Walker Art Center Reciprocal Program membership list into an intelligent, data-rich travel resource. It tracks 1,269 North American museums with priority scoring, smart travel planning features, and multi-source data enrichment pipelines. The platform enables art enthusiasts to discover, curate, and optimize museum visits based on artistic collections, location, and travel constraints.
ai_summary.purpose: To help art lovers efficiently plan and prioritize museum visits across North America by providing intelligent ranking, travel optimization, and personalized discovery tools.
tech_highlights: Data enrichment pipeline (Wikidata, Wikipedia, structured extraction)
ai_summary.target_audience: Art enthusiasts and travel planners looking to discover and optimize museum visits across North America, particularly those interested in the Walker Art Center reciprocal membership program.

repositories.name: PHPDocSpark
repositories.description: An open-source PHP documentation & data exploration platform by Mark Hazleton (WebSpark suite) showcasing hybrid server-side + modern asset pipeline techniques.

ai_summary.summary: PHPDocSpark is a PHP-based documentation and data exploration platform that combines server-side PHP processing with a modern JavaScript asset pipeline using Vite. It demonstrates hybrid development techniques within the WebSpark suite and is deployed as a live service on Azure.
ai_summary.purpose: To provide an open-source platform for exploring and documenting PHP code with integrated data visualization and AI-assisted documentation capabilities.
ai_summary.target_audience: PHP developers and technical teams seeking a self-hosted documentation and code exploration tool with modern frontend tooling.

repositories.name: PromptSpark.Chat
repositories.description: PromptSpark Chat Workflow: Real-time Conversational Flows with ASP.NET Core and Adaptive Cards

ai_summary.summary: PromptSpark Chat is a real-time conversational workflow application built with ASP.NET Core and SignalR that guides users through multi-step processes using Adaptive Cards with optional AI integration. It demonstrates dynamic chat interfaces with branching workflow logic, server-side conversation persistence, and thread-safe state management for seamless user experience across page refreshes.
ai_summary.purpose: To provide a flexible, interactive framework for building guided multi-step conversational workflows with real-time communication and optional AI-driven responses.
ai_summary.target_audience: Developers and architects looking to build interactive, real-time conversational applications with structured workflow guidance and AI integration capabilities.

repositories.name: react-native-web-start
repositories.description: A simple starter for a React Native Web application

ai_summary.summary: A production-ready starter template for building cross-platform applications using React Native Web, Vite, and TypeScript. It enables developers to write code once and deploy across web, iOS, and Android platforms with a modern development setup featuring Vite for fast web builds and React Native CLI for mobile.
ai_summary.purpose: Provides an enterprise-grade boilerplate that eliminates setup complexity for developers wanting to build true cross-platform applications with React Native Web while maintaining type safety and optimal build performance.
ai_summary.target_audience: Full-stack developers and teams seeking to build cross-platform applications with a single codebase for web, iOS, and Android using modern React and TypeScript tooling.

repositories.name: RequestSpark
repositories.description: A small console application to run REST requests

ai_summary.summary: RequestSpark is a .NET 10 web application and console tool designed for executing REST API tests, performance benchmarking, and regression testing using Postman collections. It provides a browser-based dashboard for managing API configurations, executing test runs, and analyzing results with support for load testing, OpenAPI specifications, and CSV exports.
ai_summary.purpose: To provide a comprehensive platform for automated REST API testing, performance benchmarking, and regression testing with Postman collection integration.
ai_summary.target_audience: QA engineers, API developers, and performance testers who need automated REST API testing and benchmarking capabilities with Postman collection support.

ai_summary.summary: SupportSpark is a compassionate support network platform built with TypeScript, React, Express, and Tailwind CSS that enables users to share life updates with trusted circles during challenging moments. It features role-based access control, invitation-only networks, and threaded conversations in a calm, distraction-free interface designed for sensitive contexts.
ai_summary.purpose: To provide a dedicated platform where people can efficiently keep their support networks informed during difficult life circumstances without the burden of individual notifications.
ai_summary.target_audience: Individuals navigating health challenges, life transitions, or personal journeys who want to maintain a single source of truth for updates with their support network.

repositories.name: TailwindSpark
repositories.description: A Demo of the Tailwind CSS Library

ai_summary.summary: TailwindSpark is a production-ready React TypeScript monorepo that serves as a comprehensive showcase and learning resource for Tailwind CSS 4, demonstrating modern web development patterns, design systems, and component architecture. The project features semantic design tokens, the @theme directive, and WCAG AA accessibility standards, deployed as a live interactive demo at tailwind.makeboldspark.com.
ai_summary.purpose: To provide a practical, production-quality example of building scalable React applications with Tailwind CSS 4 and modern TypeScript patterns in a monorepo structure.
ai_summary.target_audience: Frontend developers and engineers learning Tailwind CSS, React patterns, design systems, and production-ready TypeScript monorepo architecture.

repositories.name: TeachSpark
repositories.description: LLM-Powered Educational Website

ai_summary.summary: TeachSpark is an LLM-powered educational platform built with .NET 10 MVC that delivers personalized, adaptive learning experiences. The project combines a C# backend with HTML/CSS frontend to create an interactive web application that leverages Large Language Models for intelligent content adaptation and student engagement.
ai_summary.purpose: To demonstrate how modern AI language models can be integrated into educational platforms to create personalized learning pathways and improve student outcomes through adaptive content delivery.
ai_summary.target_audience: Educational institutions, EdTech companies, and developers interested in building AI-powered learning platforms and integrating LLMs into web applications.

ai_summary.summary: TexEcon is a static React application delivering expert analysis and commentary on the Texas economy, built with React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It features a sophisticated build pipeline that fetches dynamic content from the WebSpark API, generates static pages and sitemaps for SEO optimization, and deploys as a high-performance static site on GitHub Pages.
ai_summary.purpose: Provide a performant, SEO-optimized platform for Texas economic analysis and insights with dynamic content management capabilities.
ai_summary.target_audience: Users interested in Texas economic analysis, metrics, and regional insights, plus developers seeking examples of modern static site generation with dynamic content integration.

repositories.name: UISampleSpark
repositories.description: An application to demonstrate multiple ways of implementing simple maintenance (CRUD) and user interface in ASP.Net using latest public versions.

ai_summary.summary: UISampleSpark is an educational ASP.NET Core demonstration application that implements the same Employee/Department CRUD domain across seven distinct UI patterns (MVC, Razor Pages, React, Vue, htmx, Blazor, and vanilla JavaScript SPA). It serves as a technical reference for comparing modern front-end architectures within a single application, complete with theming, containerization, and CI/CD examples.
ai_summary.purpose: To provide a comprehensive, side-by-side comparison of different UI implementation patterns and frameworks within a modern ASP.NET Core application for educational and architectural decision-making.
ai_summary.target_audience: Developers and architects evaluating UI frameworks and patterns for ASP.NET Core applications, particularly those learning modern front-end approaches.

repositories.name: WebProjectMechanics
repositories.description: Web Content Management system written in ASP.Net

ai_summary.summary: WebProjectMechanics is a multi-tenant, multi-domain content management system built on ASP.NET that publishes static HTML websites from SQLite databases. It's currently undergoing a greenfield rebuild from a 20+ year legacy ASP.NET Web Forms system to .NET 9, serving 36+ domains from a single application instance with a plugin-based architecture for different content types.
ai_summary.purpose: Modernize and migrate a legacy multi-domain CMS to a contemporary .NET 9 stack while reducing infrastructure costs and improving maintainability.
ai_summary.target_audience: Organizations managing multiple web properties or content domains that need a cost-effective, self-hosted CMS solution with low infrastructure overhead.

ai_summary.summary: WebSpark is a comprehensive .NET 9 web application suite demonstrating modern ASP.NET Core MVC architecture with AI integration, real-time communication, and modular design patterns. It includes three main applications (PromptSpark, RecipeSpark, TriviaSpark) plus additional modules for content management, async operations, and identity services, with advanced SEO optimization and structured data support.
ai_summary.purpose: To serve as a practical reference implementation showcasing scalable, maintainable ASP.NET Core architecture patterns with modern web technologies and AI integration capabilities.
ai_summary.target_audience: Developers and architects seeking reference implementations of modern .NET web applications with AI integration, modular architecture, and SEO best practices.

repositories.name: WebSpark.ArtSpark
repositories.description: Art Institute Public API and WebSpark

ai_summary.summary: WebSpark.ArtSpark is a comprehensive .NET solution that provides a complete client library for the Art Institute of Chicago's public API, featuring 33 endpoint implementations across 6 categories. It includes an AI-powered chat system with multiple personas (Artwork, Artist, Curator, Historian) built with Semantic Kernel and OpenAI Vision, along with a live demo ASP.NET Core application showcasing modern .NET development practices.
ai_summary.purpose: Demonstrate a production-ready .NET ecosystem for consuming and intelligently interacting with the Art Institute's public API through AI-powered conversational interfaces.
tech_highlights: Art Institute of Chicago Public API
ai_summary.target_audience: .NET developers, API integrators, and organizations seeking AI-enhanced cultural data access and modern C# development patterns.

repositories.name: WebSpark.Bootswatch
repositories.description: A Library to allow theming of MVC Websites from Bootswatch

ai_summary.summary: WebSpark.Bootswatch is a .NET Razor Class Library that integrates Bootswatch themes into ASP.NET Core applications, providing dynamic theme switching, light/dark mode support, and caching mechanisms built on Bootstrap 5. The library enables developers to easily apply modern, responsive themes to MVC websites with minimal configuration.
ai_summary.purpose: Simplify the integration of Bootswatch Bootstrap themes into ASP.NET Core applications with dynamic theme switching and modern styling capabilities.
ai_summary.target_audience: ASP.NET Core developers building MVC websites who want to integrate professional Bootstrap themes with dynamic theme switching capabilities.

repositories.name: WebSpark.HttpClientUtility
repositories.description: HttpClientUtility for management .Net HttpClient

ai_summary.summary: WebSpark.HttpClientUtility is a drop-in .NET HttpClient wrapper that simplifies enterprise HTTP client configuration by bundling Polly resilience policies, response caching, structured logging with correlation IDs, and OpenTelemetry tracing into a single setup call. It targets .NET 8-10 LTS and eliminates boilerplate by reducing typical 50+ line configurations to one-line initialization.
ai_summary.purpose: Reduce complexity and boilerplate in .NET HttpClient setup while providing production-ready resilience, caching, and observability out-of-the-box.
ai_summary.target_audience: .NET developers building APIs and services who need enterprise-grade HTTP client resilience, caching, and observability without extensive configuration.

repositories.name: WebSpark.PrismSpark
repositories.description: Port of prismjs for .net web applications

ai_summary.summary: WebSpark.PrismSpark is a C#/.NET port of the popular PrismJS syntax highlighting library, providing advanced code highlighting capabilities for .NET web applications with support for 24 programming languages. It features a comprehensive plugin system, customizable theming, and performance-optimized async processing with caching, fully compatible with .NET 10.0 LTS.
ai_summary.purpose: To deliver enterprise-grade syntax highlighting and code formatting capabilities natively within .NET/ASP.NET Core applications without external JavaScript dependencies.
ai_summary.target_audience: ASP.NET Core developers and .NET web application builders who need sophisticated, performant syntax highlighting without relying on client-side JavaScript libraries.
